note.zh-TW: 模板用期末存貨近似平均存貨；數值受盤盈處理影響（T06）。
note.en: The template approximates average inventories with the closing balance; the result depends on how the count surplus is treated (T06).

definition.zh-TW: 存貨在一年裡賣光再補貨幾次。次數越多表示商品賣得越快、壓在倉庫裡的錢越少。
definition.en: How many times a year inventory is sold out and replenished. More turns mean goods sell faster and less money sits in the warehouse.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
